title: Opaque transaction carriers and explicit committed-state API
purpose: Make the canonical F-KT API accept only the F-KT-owned committed carrier and prevent caller mutation or forgery of candidate provenance while preserving a read-only physical snapshot seam for downstream solver adapters.

read_only_views.snapshot_rule: returned snapshots are copies; mutating them cannot mutate committed or candidate state

fsi_boundary.rule: F-KT exposes a generic cloned physical snapshot; conversion to soil_water_physical_state_t is not owned by the kernel transaction layer

fmq_observation.reason: F-MQ remains qualification-only and owns neither F-KT transaction semantics nor production scheduling

preserved_holds: B1.10 temporal-limit profile remains independently unqualified; production reference admission stays fail-closed
full reference Richards reentrancy remains F-SI work
production MultiSWAP runtime and scheduling remain outside F-KT
optional-process temporal/storage completeness remains downstream qualification work
